achievements.description: Earn all the other trophies.
achievements.hint: Earn every other trophy. There are no online trophies and no missables.

achievements.description: Win your first race in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Win any race in Adventure Mode. This naturally starts the boss progression.

achievements.description: Win against Ripper Roo in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Defeat Ripper Roo after winning the four N. Sanity Beach races required to challenge him.

achievements.description: Win against Papu Papu in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Defeat Papu Papu after progressing through The Lost Ruins.

achievements.description: Win against Komodo Joe in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Defeat Komodo Joe after progressing through Glacier Park.

achievements.display_name: Why don't you get a job?
achievements.description: Win against PinStripe in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Defeat PinStripe after progressing through Citadel City.

achievements.description: Win against Nitros Oxide in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Defeat all four previous Adventure Mode bosses to unlock the first race against Nitros Oxide.

achievements.description: Defeat Nitros Oxide in the Adventure Mode once and for all.
achievements.hint: Reach 100% Adventure Mode completion, then defeat Nitros Oxide again. This requires the Adventure races plus Relics, CTR Tokens and Gem Cups.

achievements.description: Complete a Crystal Challenge in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Complete any Adventure Mode Crystal Challenge. More Crystal Challenges are available in Local Arcade.

achievements.description: Win a CTR challenge in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: After winning a track, replay it as a CTR Challenge and collect C, T and R while still finishing first.

achievements.description: Win a Relic Race in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: After unlocking Relic Races, beat the target time on any track. Crates stop the clock for 1, 2 or 3 seconds.

achievements.description: Win a Cup Race in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Win any Gem Cup after unlocking it through the appropriate complete set of CTR Tokens.

achievements.description: Earn all the Relics in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Earn at least a Sapphire Relic on every required Adventure Mode Relic Race; Gold and Platinum Relics are not required.

achievements.description: Earn all the Gems in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Collect all CTR Tokens, grouped by color, to unlock every Gem Cup and win each Cup.

achievements.description: Earn all the CTR Tokens in the Adventure Mode.
achievements.hint: Complete the CTR Challenges across the Adventure tracks by collecting C, T and R and finishing first.

achievements.description: Win a race with less than 0.3 seconds between you and the second place.
Hit two opponents with a single Bowling Bomb.
achievements.hint: A Bowling Bomb must hit two opponents with one explosion. Battle Mode or local multiplayer can make this easier.

achievements.description: Do a Super Boost.
achievements.hint: Perform a drift boost immediately after starting a drift when the boost meter is in the optimal zone.

achievements.description: Win a boss challenge without getting hit by any of the boss' Power-Ups.
achievements.hint: Any Adventure boss challenge works. Avoid every Power-Up fired or placed by the boss.

achievements.description: Drift 15 Times in a row during a race.
achievements.hint: Chain 15 drifts consecutively in one race. A wide, safe track makes this easier.

achievements.description: Successfully use all three Turbo Boost charges 5 times in a row during a race.
achievements.hint: Build and release all three drift-boost charges five times consecutively without breaking the sequence.

achievements.description: Drift Boost a total of 500 times.
achievements.hint: This is cumulative. Every successful Drift Boost counts toward the total of 500.

achievements.description: Complete the Adventure Mode on the Hard difficulty.
achievements.hint: Start a Nitro-Fueled Adventure on Hard. Only the 16 main Adventure races and the first Nitros Oxide victory are required; collectibles can be skipped.

achievements.description: Finish first when you were last on the final lap.
Block an incoming missile with all of the following Power-Ups: Beaker, Crate, Bowling Bomb.
achievements.hint: Block incoming missiles by throwing a Beaker, Crate and Bowling Bomb behind you on separate successful blocks.

achievements.description: Beat all of Nefarious Tropy's times in Time Trial Mode.
achievements.hint: Beat N. Tropy's ghost on every required CTR and CNK Time Trial. You must first set a qualifying time to unlock each ghost.

achievements.description: Beat all of Nitros Oxide's times in Time Trial Mode.
achievements.hint: N. Oxide's ghost only becomes available after beating N. Tropy on that track. Beat Oxide on all required CTR and CNK trials.

achievements.description: Win a race without using any Power-Ups.
Finish first on all tracks. (CTR & CNK)
achievements.hint: Finish first on every CTR and CNK track, including the full track roster counted by the game.

achievements.description: Successfully land all three missiles from a Triple Missile Power-Up.
Use every Power-Up once. (Race & Battle Arena)
achievements.hint: Use every standard Power-Up at least once across Race and Battle Arena modes.

achievements.description: Use the shortcut in Cortex Castle.
achievements.hint: Use the Cortex Castle shortcut at least once.

achievements.description: Use the shortcut in Polar Pass.
achievements.hint: Use the Polar Pass shortcut at least once.

achievements.description: Use all of Blizzard Bluff's shortcuts in the same race.
achievements.hint: Take every Blizzard Bluff shortcut during the same race.

achievements.description: Use all of Papu's Pyramid's shortcuts in the same race.
achievements.hint: Take every Papu's Pyramid shortcut during the same race.

achievements.description: Use the shortcut in Crash Cove.
achievements.hint: Use the Crash Cove shortcut.

achievements.description: Use the shortcut in Sewer Speedway.
achievements.hint: Use the Sewer Speedway shortcut.

achievements.description: Use the shortcut in Tiger Temple.
achievements.hint: Use the Tiger Temple shortcut.

achievements.description: Use the shortcut in Dragon Mines without being crushed.
achievements.hint: Take the Dragon Mines shortcut without being crushed.

achievements.description: Earn all the shortcut trophies.
achievements.hint: Earn all eight shortcut-related trophies: Cortex Castle, Polar Pass, Blizzard Bluff, Papu's Pyramid, Crash Cove, Sewer Speedway, Tiger Temple and Dragon Mines.

achievements.description: Use all Juiced Up Power-Ups once. (Race & Battle Arena)
achievements.hint: Collect 10 Wumpa Fruit to juice a Power-Up, then use every Juiced Up Power-Up at least once across Race or Battle Arena.

achievements.description: Sustain your boost for a whole lap.
achievements.hint: Maintain a continuous boost for an entire lap. Tracks with long drift chains and Sacred Fire make this easier.

achievements.description: Win a match in every type of Battle Mode.
achievements.hint: Win at least one match in each Battle Mode type.

achievements.description: Free yourself from a TNT crate.
achievements.hint: Shake off a TNT crate before it explodes by repeatedly hopping.

achievements.description: Directly hit an opponent with a thrown Beaker Power-Up.
achievements.hint: Throw a Beaker directly into an opponent rather than relying on them driving into it.

achievements.description: Customize your ride.
achievements.hint: Change any kart customization option such as body, paint job, wheels, decal or character setup.

achievements.description: Unlock all characters from the original roster.
achievements.hint: Unlock every character from the original CTR roster through Adventure Mode progression and the game's character unlock conditions.

achievements.description: Complete all Crystal Challenges. (CTR & CNK)
achievements.hint: Complete all Crystal Challenges from both CTR and CNK content; Adventure Mode challenges count toward the total.
